The only issue with pro life, because I know it comes from a good heart, is that you can’t makes laws and policies on something that circumstancial, there is always something that could go wrong as everyone’s body is different. So someone in the third trimester could need an emergency abortion- but the baby might be able to survive it. But sometimes the baby didn’t develop properly and in the third trimester is doesnt have a skull- or it died, which can kill the mother if its not aborted ASAP. Another issue, is that so many people are uneducated on what abortion is- it is a medical removal of a fetus. That’s it. There’s only a negative connotation because of politics. It’s very rare that women get abortions just because. They need to be made accessible for women as we have a right to life too.
